pipelines.name: genai_pipeline
pipelines.pipeline: {auto_source} ! decodebin ! videoconvert ! tee name=split  split. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=1 max-size-time=0 max-size-bytes=0 ! videorate drop-only=true ! video/x-raw,format=BGRA,framerate=2/1 ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=1 max-size-time=0 max-size-bytes=0 ! gvagenai name=captioner device=CPU model-path="/home/pipeline-server/models/{parameters[captioner_model_name]}" generation-config="max_new_tokens={parameters[captioner_max_new_tokens]}" frame-rate=2 chunk-size=1 metrics=true ! queue ! gvametaconvert add-empty-results=true name=metaconvert ! gvametapublish name=destination ! fakesink sync=false  split. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=1 max-size-time=0 max-size-bytes=0 ! videoconvert ! videorate drop-only=true ! video/x-raw,format=NV12,framerate=30/1 ! queue max-size-buffers=1 leaky=downstream ! appsink name=appsink sync=false max-buffers=1 drop=true

captioner-prompt.default: Describe what you see in the image in one sentence.
